description: This file defines Express.js route handlers related to session management, including tenant listing, tenant selection, setting active tenant, and toggling super admin mode. It handles authentication, authorization, audit logging, and sets cookies or headers accordingly.

methods.name: router.get('/tenants')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list authorized tenants for the current user, with audit logging.

methods.name: router.post('/tenant')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to set the active tenant in session, with validation, RBAC check, audit log, and cookie setting.

methods.name: router.post('/tenants/select')
methods.description: Alias route to select active tenant, internally redirecting to the /tenant handler.

methods.name: router.post('/all-tenants')
methods.description: Allows super admins to toggle the global 'all-tenants' mode, affecting the request scope, with audit logging.
